newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian share prices ease in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Estonian share prices ease in lower volume.

text.p: Trading on the Estonian stock exchange was quiet on Tuesday with volumes well down and prices easing slightly, dealers said.
Trade fell to 20.7 million kroons, a third of yesterday's and the Tallinn stock exchange index fell 0.68 to 179.27.
But dealers said the market was stable with most prices easing only a little as interest from private investors kept the market alive.
"Prices came down slightly with small investors showing the greatest interest. The market looks stable and we don't expect any dramatic changes", said one dealer.
Hoiupank was most active with 10.6 million kroons of shares traded to close down 1.65 kroons at 79.25 kroons.
Forekspank was 3.49 kroons weaker and finished at 135.46 and turned over four million kroons.
One dealer said:"The share speculators have taken their money and moved on to neighbouring bourses."
Hansapank was down 0.50 kroons to end the day at 170.60 kroons with only 1.8 million kroons worth of stocks traded.
Tallinna Pank closed unchanged at 64 kroons with a turnover of 1.6 million kroons.
Trade on the over-the-counter market picked up today with 13.3 million kroons changing hands.
Saku Brewery led trade with a turnover of 4.3 million kroons to close at 51 kroons, up one kroon.
The Rakvere meat plant turned over 3.9 million kroons with its price easing slightly to close 0.25 kroons down at 12.45 kroons.
